title: malva maroccana
intro: Malva maroccana, commonly known as Mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Malva maroccana include anti-inflammatory, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerogenic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
